S1:12.text: Therfore the. ſonnes of Ia- cob did as he commanded them:

S1:14.text: And Ioſeph returned into Egypt with his brethren, and with al the traine, his father being buried.

S1:19.text: To whom he anſwered Fearc not can we reſiſt the wil of God

S1:20.text: "You thought euil againſt me but God turned that into good, th'it he might exalt me, as preſently you ſee, and might ſaue many peoples.

S1:22.text: And he dwelt in Ægypt, with al his fathers houſe and liued an hundred and tenne yeares. And he ſawe the children of Ephraim vnto the third generation. Alſo the children of Macbit the ſonne of Manaſſes were borne in Ioſephs knees

S1:23.text: Which things being done, he ſpake to his brethren After my death God wil viſite you, and wil make you goe vp out of this land, to the land which he ſware to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.

S1:24.text: And when he had adiured them and ſaid God wil viſite you, carie my bones with you out of this place

S1:25.text: he died, being an hundred and tenne yeares old. And being embawmed with ſpices, was put in a coffin in Ægypt.

S3:12.text: Therfore the, ſonnes of Ia- cob did as he commanded them:

S3:13.text: and carying him into the Land of Chanaan, they buried him in the duble caue, which Abraham had bought with the field for a poſſeſſion. to burie in of Ephron the Hethite againſt Mambre.

S3:14.text: And Ioſeph returned into Ægypt with his brethren, and with al the traine, his father being buried.

S3:15.text: After whoſe death, his brethren fearing, and talking one with an other: Leſt perhaps he be mindful of the iniurie which he ſuffered, and requite vs al the euil that we haue done,

S3:19.text: To whom he anſwered Feare not can we reſiſt the wil of God

S3:20.text: "You thought euil againſt me but God turned that into good, that he might exalt me, as preſently you ſee, and might ſaue many peoples.

S3:21.text: Feare not I wil feed you & your lir'e ones, and he comforted them, and ſpake gently & mildly.

S3:22.text: And he dwelt in Ægypt, with al his fathers houſe and liued an hundred and tenne yeares. And he ſawe the children of Ephraim vnto the third generation. Alſo the children of Machir the ſonne of Manaſſes were borne in Ioſephs knees.

S3:23.text: Which thinges being done, he ſpake to his brethren After my death God wil viſite you, and wil make you goe vp out of this land, to the land which he ſware to Abraham, Iſaac, and Iacob.

S3:24.text: And when he had adiured them and ſaid God wil viſite you, carie my bones with you out of this place

S3:25.text: he died, being an hundred and tenne yeares old. And being embawmed with ſpices, was put in a coffin in Ægypt.

S6:6.text: And Pharao ſaid to him Goe vp and burie thy father as thou waſt adiured.

S6:7.text: Who going vp, there went with him al the ancients of Pharaos houſe, and al the elders of the Land of Ægypt:

S6:9.text: He had alſo in his traine chariots and horſemen and it became no ſmal multitude.

S9:3.text: Who fufilling his commandements, there paſſed fourtie dayes for this was the maner of corſes embawmed, and Ægypt mourned him ſeuentie daies
